_comment: One-line purposes for files with no usable header comment. `fallback` applies only when the file yields no purpose of its own (header comment, export doc comment, or derived); `replace` always wins, for files whose header comment is misleading. Prefer adding a header comment to the file itself. See /reference/code-map.

replace.drizzle.config.ts: drizzle-kit config pointing at lib/db/schema.ts and the drizzle migrations folder for PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL.
replace.lib/agents/researcher.ts: Builds the main researcher ToolLoopAgent for chat turns: resolves turn mode, assembles search/fetch tools and source prompts, and applies search-mode settings.
replace.lib/analytics/index.ts: Barrel module re-exporting the PostHog analytics trackers (chat, account, adaptive-limit events), event types and query-shape utilities.
replace.lib/db/migrate.ts: Standalone script that runs Drizzle migrations from the drizzle folder against DATABASE_URL, honoring DATABASE_SSL_DISABLED.
replace.lib/embeddings/transformers-embedding.ts: Server-side text embedding via a remote embedding service or local @huggingface/transformers ONNX pipelines, with model registry and cosine similarity.
replace.lib/model-selector/pick-fallback-model.t: Chooses the model shown when no model cookie exists: DEFAULT_MODEL if its provider is enabled and listed, else the first available model.
replace.lib/quotes/couchbase-quotes.ts: Server-only loader that reads the quotes document from Couchbase using COUCHBASE_* env vars over a cached cluster connection, returning [] on any failure.
replace.lib/utils/decode-html-entities.ts: Small dependency-free decoder for common named and numeric HTML entities in search-source text such as Discover feed titles.
replace.lib/utils/telemetry.ts: Helper that reports whether Langfuse tracing is enabled via the ENABLE_LANGFUSE_TRACING env flag.
replace.scripts/chat-cli.ts: CLI script that sends a message to the Ask /api/chat endpoint and streams the response for manual testing of chat, search modes and regeneration.
replace.vitest.config.mts: Root Vitest config for Ask using jsdom, @ and server-only aliases, and excluding worktrees, the model-manager app and docs-site.
